name: core
description: CORE — a project intelligence agent that knows your project across sessions, surfaces decisions and risks proactively, and challenges overconfidence. Type `/core` to start. Single agent with a unit-based memory architecture, retrieval ladder, and rendered project synthesis; reaches for multi-agent adversarial analysis when stakes warrant. `/core` itself resumes a project across sessions. Ships with eight companion utilities — `/finalize` (session close), `/refocus` (recenter mid-session on what matters most now, read-only by default), `/process-memory` (user-invoked memory hygiene pass), `/register-sources` (external source registration), `/vibecheck` (session vibe), `/configure-project` (project bootstrap + health check), `/metrics` (the one door to memory health: plain-language answers by default, with full/export/self-test modes), `/memory-view` (user-confirmed read-only memory-snapshot page for private artifact publish) — that CORE invokes internally and that you can also call directly. One deprecation shim, `/orient`, still forwards to `/core`.
